svg.aria-label: Left: GAE weights decay as (gamma lambda) to the power l; lambda 0 keeps only the first TD error, lambda 1 keeps all. Right: with a biased critic, bias squared falls and variance rises as lambda goes from 0 to 1, and the total error is lowest at an intermediate lambda
